# Folio by Zip1

Folio is the web search page at https://www.zip1.ai/. A query can include web results, and Wikipedia and Grokipedia when those sources are switched on.

- [Search](https://www.zip1.ai/): the search box
- [About](https://www.zip1.ai/about): what Folio by Zip1 is
- [How to search](https://www.zip1.ai/how-to-search): the search box, source switches, results, and page controls
- [Privacy policy](https://www.zip1.ai/privacy): what Folio sends to its server and search sources, and what stays in the browser

Addresses that contain a search query are the same search page, not separate articles.

A function query such as "y = sin(x)" or "plot x^2" draws the graph inside that one AI answer on the search page. The plot is computed in the browser. The model is told the function and the range, so the written answer is about the curve rather than unrelated results. The graph itself is not part of the bot search JSON.

Bot search is `GET https://www.zip1.ai/api/search`. `q` is required and limited to 180 characters. `web`, `wiki`, and `grok` are `1` or `0` and default to `1`. `images` and `ai` are `1` or `0` and default to `0`. `ai_model` is `grok`, `openai`, or `claude` and picks the AI provider (default: the first one that is set up, in that order). `webPage`, `wikiPage`, `grokPage`, and `imagesPage` start at 1. Web returns up to 10 results, Wikipedia 8, Grokipedia 12, and Images 24 (up to 10 pages; each image result adds `image`, `thumbnail`, and, when known, `width` and `height`). With `ai=1` the response adds an `ai` block: `status` (`ok`, `unconfigured`, `no-context`, or `error`), and either `provider` (the one that answered), `model`, `text` with `[n]` markers, and `citations` (`n`, `source`, `title`, `url`), or a short `message`. `failed` lists providers that were tried first and did not answer. The AI answer is written by Grok (xAI), ChatGPT (OpenAI), or Claude (Anthropic) from the top results of every source that is on, including Images, and can be wrong. The search does not run when `web`, `wiki`, `grok`, and `images` are all `0`; `ai` does not count as a source on its own.
